title: Review of c03's FCH cargo-fission (SIWD): S, I, D and the chi=0 ablation replicate on seed 17; a barrier-free 100x-slower cargo also passes the 2x test
summary: Fresh seed 17 labkit re-run (T=800): ~29 micelles from white noise, 50 persistent splits, max generation 5, merge/split 0.03; every body-frame holds the self-made cargo at >= 2x (aggregate 1137x at t=80, 740x at t=800) and random fissions give two daughters at ~400-600x from parents at ~1000x. chi=0 on the same seed: same bodies, contrast 1.6 -> 1.0, 1% of body-frames >= 2x. The matched lowered-D twin (chi=0, Dc/100) also keeps >= 2x in 99.3% of body-frames, as a diffuse halo whose contrast decays 226 -> 3.6 while the world stays at ~740x. W passes its gate as written (the wall ablation removes it) but not the beyond-diffusion test at the 2x threshold; the partition shows as a 200x difference in magnitude and as confinement to each core.

observations.S: rerun/seed17/sheet.png t=0: white noise over the whole domain; ~29 micelles by t=32
observations.I: rerun/seed17/sheet.png t=32-800: discrete round micelles of stable size; lineage.png tracks persist hundreds of time units
observations.W: contrast_seed17.txt: 100% of 6589 body-frames >= 2x, aggregate 740-1137x; rerun_chi0/seed17: 1.0-1.6x with the same bodies
observations.D: rerun/seed17/lineage.png: 50 persistent splits, max generation 5, 2 merges, 0 remerged; fission_strips_rerun_seed17.png: 4 random splits, both daughters separate and >= 400x

seeds_run.result: chi=0, Dc/100: still >= 2x in 99.3% of body-frames

verdicts.limitation: The containment is a Boltzmann partition (c ~ exp(-chi u)) of a cargo made only inside the bodies: a 100x slower cargo with no partition also stays >= 2x in 99.3% of body-frames for T=800 (falling to 3.6x), so the 2x criterion does not need the wall operator; only the magnitude and the confinement to each core do. The cargo is passive, division is feed-driven in synchronized waves, and there are no deaths (29 -> 89 micelles).
